title: Coffee, Tea & Caffeine Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=teatimer:session) OR (index=personal sourcetype=beanconqueror:brew)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="teatimer:session","primary",sourcetype="beanconqueror:brew","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from teatimer:session and beanconqueror:brew to see whether two coffee, tea feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `teatimer:session` and `beanconqueror:brew` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main coffee, tea data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
